answer_1.quote: We propose three text infilling tasks based on key markers in spoken discourse: (i) Discourse Connectives, (ii) Quantifiers, and (iii) Stance Markers ... The text infilling task, similar to the Cloze task in linguistics, involves predicting missing words based on its surrounding context.
answer_1.outputs: Predicted discourse markers (connectives, quantifiers, stance markers) for masked positions

answer_2.quote: Overall, the results indicate that incorporating gestures alongside text enhances the model's performance in spoken discourse modeling. This improvement is particularly pronounced in terms of the F1 score, with an average gain of 4.8% across all three tasks.
